pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-rectangular regions with soft-to-medium edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank show larger spatial area and greater elongation compared to the smaller, more densely clustered patches on the shoulder and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively wide and consistent across the flank, narrowing slightly at the transition to the limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck mane, formed by dense, short hair pixels projecting vertically from the dorsal line.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural occlusion in the continuous mane line is present on the upper shoulder, caused by the overlapping silhouette of an avian organism.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a red-billed oxpecker perched on the dorsal ridge. Pronounced vertical skin folds and muscular striations are visible in the lower neck and pectoral region.
